text: Do not go to sleep without saying these three things to God. The last one will quiet your heart. One. God, thank you for everything I did not understand today. The delays. The closed doors. The moments that felt like setbacks.

You were there, and I trust your hand even when I cannot see your plan. Two. I surrender what I cannot control. Every fear, every weight, every what if. I lay it down. I am not going to bed carrying what was never mine to carry. Three. Give me peace tonight. Not just sleep. Peace. Quiet my mind. Calm my heart.

And remind me that good things are still working, even while I rest. A prayer at night opens the door. But peace that stays must be built in the day. I spent over forty years learning in silence how to build it.
Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
